title: Android Wear 2.0 Complications with Medtronic
symptom: Complications on Android Wear 2.0 show 'Null' when using xDrip+ with Medtronic Uploader or in follow mode.
cause: The 640G data comes in via the 'Nightscout Emulation' route and may not be relayed properly to the watch for complications to work.
fix: A workaround was provided by gregorybel in a branch, but it is described as a dirty workaround, not a proper solution.
evidence_quote: I think its possible that because of the way the 640G data comes in to the system via the `Nightscout Emulation` route that it doesn't get relayed properly to the watch in a way that is needed for complications to work.
